registry_case.title: Extended Lorenz-84 eq-f
registry_case.manual_source: Reviewed three-tool promotion, Claude (review delegated by owner, 2026-10-28), 2026-10-29

model_contract.time: original nondimensional time; no time rescaling
model_contract.jacobian: rows are RHS components; columns follow X,Y,Z,U
model_contract.frequency: angular frequency in radians per original time unit
model_contract.fold_label: LP (BK fold aliases normalized by the exporter)
model_contract.hopf_label: H (BK hopf aliases normalized by the exporter)
model_contract.bt_label: BT; two small eigenvalues and geometric nullity one
model_contract.normal_forms: record tool-native definition and eigenvector normalization; no implicit l1 conversion
model_contract.arclength: record physical metric and state/parameter weights per tool
model_contract.chart_boundary: Hopf chart termination near BT is a boundary, not a BT detection

f_sweep.comparison_domain: clip each sheet to bounds before matching

codim2.source: historical lorenz84_codim2.jl; shared positive-T BT chart

model_contract.coverage_note: BT is a refined point selected in a window; Hopf may terminate at a chart boundary, which cannot pass full-domain publication

registry_case.comparison_window_comment: Both fold arms; upper bound 2.99 is strictly inside MatCont coverage ending at F=2.997528062547353 and the other tools. The fold at F=1.546648 lies below the window.
